question: Should this PR carry the broad durable queue-owned media handoff as the supported fix for Codex generated-image duplicate/drop behavior, or should it be narrowed to typed result-byte transfer before merge?
rationale: The upstream Codex contract supports persisting typed result bytes, but this branch also changes delivery queue media ownership and is currently dirty against main, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent merge shape or proof bar.

options.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
options.body: Resolve the conflict while preserving current-main app-inventory and outbound delivery semantics, then require focused outbound/gateway media tests plus live generated-image delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Codex transfer
options.body: Split the durable queue-media receipt work away if maintainers want the result-byte bug fixed with less message-delivery surface area.

options.title: Pause for replacement branch
options.body: If conflict resolution becomes branch reconstruction, keep this PR as source context and ask for a clean maintainer-pushable replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict while preserving current-main app-inventory and outbound delivery semantics, then require focused outbound/gateway media tests plus live generated-image delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across Codex app-server routing and outbound delivery queue ownership decisions touched by this PR.
